items.description: Installable software (currently private beta) to help you learn more about your community thanks to different search criteria and filters that can be applied to your followers and friends. SocialBro's technology allows you to download all your community to your PC and browse them even if you are offline. SocialBro will be available as an Adobe Air desktop application and as a Google Chrome App.

Breadcrumbs is a free cutting edge online GPS track management software allowing you to upload GPS tracks with photos and videos for all of your adventures. You will be able to share them with your friends and connect to people who have the same interest as you. Breadcrumbs revolves around Google Earth, which is embedded in your browser.
VG Sammenlign allows you to compare fees, interest, and costs of 26 consumer loans in Norway. VG.no is Norway's largest newspaper and most visited website.
An interactive map that displays news for the specific country you click on. A Google Maps, Google News, and Geonames.org mashup.
Journey of Barack Obama from his birth place in Honolulu, Hawaii, to possibly the White House.
KeepTheRecord provides an instant online conference call for up to 10 participants, with only one click. When the conference is over, everyone gets to keep a copy of the recording.
Combines digg-like voting system with maps and other utilities for travelers.

With Showrooms you are able to playfully present your products as interactive shop app. It's an HTML5 based video application that imports all required product information via the Goole Shopping API. Site is in German.
Java API wrapper library for Safe Creative copyright registry service.
An online language-learning site providing tutoring and coaching for Arabic, French, and Spanish.

FindGreatColleges.com has information on over 7000 colleges and universities in US. You can find general information, offerings, enrollment, admission, tuition, room and board information on most of the colleges in US.
Created for Photo Hack Day 2011, Tag Fight! participants send texts to fight over what type of photos to display full-screen.
This mashup allows Box.net users to create physical mailers directly from their Box accounts using pictures they have stored.

trendalicious is a near real-time view of website popularity trends as reflected by the del.icio.us social bookmarking service. All URLs posted by a minimum of two people in past sixty minutes are displayed, ranked by the total number of recent posts.
This mashup is a fun tool that allows users to discover who they love on Twitter. You can search using any twitter handle and see who the user loves.

OggChat is a live chat solution for website support and sales that integrates with Google Talk and GMail. It incorporates features such as custom chat windows and skills based routing, but routes all chats directly to each operator's Google Talk acc
Shows a random Google Street View, with the ability to choose by continent or country. There's also a beta feature to restrict rural roadways.
A WordPress Plugin that conveniently displays an agent's AgentRank data- profile, sales, reviews, forecasts, etc., from RealtyBaron.
Online travel blog with Flickr photo integration.

Not for the easily offended. William and Kate have just completed their wedding vows and are standing outside the Abbey, surrounded by onlookers, and appear to be unaware of the oncoming zombie hordes. Undercover agents and body guards are scattered throughout the crowd, however they are greatly outnumbered... Watch how it all unfolds in Binary Space's game, Class 3 Outbreak.
An app that uses SoundClouds API to play songs from the cloud on your profile. PHP source code available.
Automate downloads of your website traffic data from your Google Analytics account directly into Excel.

Raise the Money is an online company that provides an application that allows political candidates and committees to accept donations/contributions on their websites. Raise the Money is a platform that connects political candidates with their supporters from around the web.
Google Gadget that lets you run Google Map searches directly from your Google homepage.
AccentTraining.net is a mashup of Twilio, Amazon Mechanical Turk and Recurly APIs to create an accent rating and training service. Create a recording and have it rated by real American residents.

Once upon a time, a musicologist was wondering if his music collection was complete. He began to research his last.fm's library to find lost albums. As time pasted by, he reckoned a better way was in order. This site followed shortly.
5 planes taking off one after the other from the same runway in Atlanta. Click on the numbered markers to see the sequence. Not sure if they are same or different.

The GET DigitalHealth mashup enables a clinical trial sponsor, clinical research organization or an academic researcher/investigators to set up a study, select wearables/devices and start receiving data from study participants. Participants have to click on an invite link, sign the consent, and provide authorization for the device data to be accessed by Get DigitalHealth. The platform provides study teams the ability to export data to a spreadsheet, visualize or directly push data to clinical trial management systems such as the Medidata and OpenClinical. The mashup features insightful analytics, HIPAA compliant security, normalized, intelligent data retrieval, intergration with EHR and CTMS, and more.
You select your desired locations, such as all of the cities you have lived in, then the map will display all of your cities along with the exact midpoint for those places.
Worldwide dive site atlas and reference. Hundreds of dive sites from all continents listed. Sites mapped on Google Maps.
YouTube search engine with results in RSS or JSON.
Online classifieds and advertisements service with video and Google Maps. Users can post video footage of their classifieds and ads, along with images and audio. View classifieds and ads on a map.
NewsShare leverages Twitter to provide up-to-date news. Enter keywords for tracking news. Listen to news.
Measures the distance between two locations.
The True Knowledge Firefox add-on enhances your search engine results by inserting a direct answer to your question above your regular search results.

We search, we filter, we adjust, we categorize the infos and this in a single SERP. Because all we wanted is to learn, discover and dream. Others call it Beta Mode, we call it learning Stage. Gool.li algorithm needs to be enhanced by your usage, comments and support! Gool.li is crafted by : Mohamed Kahlain & Jawad Jari
Integrates Netflix into Facebook. Allows you to add movies, see friends with Netflix, and display your queue and movies at home on your Facebook profile.

Daily Crypto lets you add crypto tokens to easily track their prices, price change & 24h highs and lows in your new browser tab! Daily Crypto replaces your default tab, and lets you easily access latest token prices of your curated selection of crypto tokens. From latest token prices, to price %age changes, 24 hour highs, lows and market cap ranks - we keep you updated.
Interactive map, heatmaps, a geo-location mobile version, data feeds, and detail pages of every Cleanup Site and Permitted Facility from the CA Department of Toxic Substances Control Datasets.
TwitAku.com provides a Twitter service: Twitter Signatures which generates an image with user's latest Tweet message, follower and friends status

Refinansiere.net is a Norwegian portal which compares rates and terms on various refinancing offers. That includes annual percentage rates, downpayment times and various miscellaneous costs charged by each lender. Numbers are fetched through the API of Finansportalen, a portal run by the Norwegian government through which bank and finance institutions upload their data. Refinansiere.net seeks to help consumers make the right financial choice, based on their individual financial situation.
KivaAlerts.com is an alerts application built on the Kiva.org API to let you know when loans of your interest appear on Kiva.org.
